articles.title: Newegg Has the Least Overpriced 32GB of DDR5 6000MHz CL 30 Desktop Memory
articles.summary: RAM is expensive and there's no way of getting around it. If you're going to upgrade your existing memory or build a PC from scratch, you just have to accept the fact that your budget needs to accommodate for today's RAM prices. Still not fazed?
body: For a limited time, you can pick up 32GB (2x16GB) of the V-COLOR Manta XSky DDR5-6000MHz CL30 Desktop Memory for $369.59 with free shipping. You'll need to be signed into your AliExpress account and then click on the link to see the pricing. If the page says it's not available for shipping, reload a couple of times (sometimes it's actually out of stock, sometimes it's just a glitch). If you buy it directly from Newegg's site, you're going to pay $420 for the same RAM.

V-COLOR is a well known memory brand. The Manta XSky DDR5 RAM in particular uses SK Hynix ICs, which are considered one of the best memory chips you can get. The RAM is meant for AMD systems (although it could work with Intel) since it's preloaded with an AMD EXPO overclocking profile and not Intel XMP. The rated speed of 6,000MHz and CAS latency of 30 is considered the sweet spot for AMD CPUs. Unless you're going after benchmark leaderboards (and hve a LOT of disposable cash), RAM with higher speeds and lower memory latencies are wasted on gaming builds.
Is it better to wait for RAM to go down in price? Unless you're willing to wait a few years, probably not.
points: RAM is expensive and there's no way of getting around it.
If you're going to upgrade your existing memory or build a PC from scratch, you just have to accept the fact that your budget needs to accommodate for today's RAM prices.

articles.title: The Duskbloods Playtest Was Even More Popular Than Elden Ring Nightreign’s
articles.summary: It sounds like fans were eager to learn everything they could about From Software's The Duskbloods, as one of the game's producers has revealed the Switch 2 exclusive saw higher playtest sign-ups compared to Elden Ring Nightreign.
body: Speaking during a livestream hosted by Japanese gaming publication Famitsu (and translated by GamesRadar+ ), From Software producer Yasuhiro Kitao stated the number of applications for The Duskbloods playtest eclipsed that of the developer's previous multiplayer experiment.

Given that Elden Ring Nightreign's playtest was available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S (the full game was also available on PC and last-gen consoles) the fact that The Duskbloods received more interest on Switch 2 sounds like it should be impossible. The Switch 2 is also a relatively new console, having only been available for around a year, meaning its user base is much smaller compared to that of the other two consoles.

While it is surprising on the surface, perhaps there is some logic to be deciphered here. Elden Ring Nightreign went on to sell more than 5 million copies, with its DLC alone selling 2 million copies in under a week. The game's popularity and success proved From Software could make a wildly fun, multiplayer-focused souls-like, perhaps generating more interest for The Duskbloods.

articles.title: The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past Expansion Confirmed to Include More Gwent, and Everyone Is Already Celebrating
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red has confirmed The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt 's upcoming Songs of the Past expansion will come with more Gwent, and card game lovers are already celebrating. The Witcher 3 earned a lot of praise when it launched back in 2015.
body: "In Gwent, gamers clash with friends in fast-paced duels that combine skill-based play with bluffing, and careful deck construction," an official description from CD Projekt Red says. "The game is played over a best-of-three series of rounds, as players unleash their hand by slinging spells and diverse units with special abilities, and use clever tricks to deceive their opponents."

CD Projekt Red's in-universe card game first launched within the third installment in its Witcher series before being transformed into a standalone spinoff in 2017 and a real-life tabletop experience in 2025. It's a formula others have unsuccessfully attempted to mimic, but few have managed to stand the test of time quite like Gwent. That's probably exactly why it will be making a comeback when the developer returns to The Witcher 3 with its Songs of the Past expansion in 2027.

CD Projekt Red community and social media manager Marcin Łukaszewski teased the return of the fan-favorite side activity when replying to a player on X/Twitter. When the fan said they hoped more Gwent would be included in the surprise expansion, Łukaszewski offered a simple reply: "Confirmed!"

articles.title: The FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer Drops to Just $203 Shipped at AliExpress
articles.summary: An excellent 3D printer with multi-color print capability just got a huge price drop as part of AliExpress' Back to School Sale. For a limited time, get the FlashForge AD5X 3D Printer with integrated multi-material printing system for just $203.16 after you apply coupon code " JJX32B ".
body: Make sure you're signed into your account to see the shipping options (you may have to refresh the page twice ). You're buying it from FlashForge's official store on AliExpress. It ships free from the United States and arrives within 1 to 2 weeks.

The AD5X is the least expensive FlashForge printer that offers multi material printing, which basically allows you to use multiple colors or multiple filament types on a single 3D print. It also features a CoreXY structure, which is rare for a printer in this price range. In a CoreXY printer, only the print head moves while the motors are permanently fixed. Since the motors are generally the heaviest component, this improves print speed and precision.

The AD5X features an open bed design with a working space measuring approximately 8.7" cubed. For those of you who are looking to enclose the chamber in order to create a more stable environment for your prints, you can purchase the official $50 kit. Alternatively, you can save the money simply by putting a box over the printer.

articles.title: I Can’t Believe I Missed Mortal Shell 2’s Best Item, Silly Me
articles.summary: From awesome Tarstones to exceptional weapons, there are a lot of really good items to find in Mortal Shell 2. While you can miss them if you're not doing your due diligence while exploring, there's an early-game item that you really don't want to miss because of how it trivializes most fights.
body: The first boss you fight happens in the prologue. After some light exploration and acquiring your first shell, Haros, you roll up on the Tar Golem, who absolutely wrecks your stuff. It's designed as a forced loss, so actually putting up a fight is pointless, especially since a cutscene plays showing that Haros saves your life anyway.

It's here that you loot your now-dead shell for the Vatra's Seal, which hardens your body to nullify incoming damage and freezes you mid-animation. It's actually a pretty overpowered seal. Not only does it cancel out damage, causing enemies to get knocked back if they attack your shell, but it also acts as an animation cancel, letting you interrupt your attacks by hardening your body to guard. Time the harden just right and you've got a perfect parry, which deals massive posture damage and eventually leads to a counterattack.

Vatra's Seal is essentially the main ability from the first Mortal Shell. But instead of it being tied to one specific shell, when you loot Haros' corpse in the sequel, you can harden your body no matter which shell you currently have equipped. It rules.
points: From awesome Tarstones to exceptional weapons, there are a lot of really good items to find in Mortal Shell 2.

articles.title: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Is Way Ahead Of Black Ops 7 Already By One Metric
articles.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is nearing 400,000 copies sold on Steam already, and that's well ahead of where last year's Black Ops 7 stood at launch on Valve's platform.
body: Elliott said Black Ops 7 managed to hit around 200,000 copies pre-sold on Steam by launch. Modern Warfare 4 has doubled that, and with two months still to go before release.

MW4's beta put up big numbers on Steam during its early-access period, reaching a peak of more than 115,000 concurrent users. Black Ops 7, meanwhile, peaked at about 100,000 concurrent users on Steam, even after it went live for everyone outside of a beta weekend, according to ChalieIntel.

MW4 performing better than Black Ops 7 by some metrics already is not a total surprise, as last year's game was a commercial disappointment. In fact, its sales ranking in the US was the lowest for the series since 2008.

The next MW4 beta is coming up this weekend, running August 28-September 1. This will be an open beta, so anyone on any platform can play without needing to preorder. Additionally, this beta will extend to Nintendo Switch 2.

articles.title: $7 Billion Dragon Ball Z Theme Park Officially in the Works
articles.summary: Dragon Ball Z is known for fusion and team-ups, but this is one pairing we didn't see coming. On Monday, the Élysée Palace announced France and Saudi Arabia will collaborate to build a manga -themed amusement park inspired by Dragon Ball Z in France.
body: According to a report from Reuters, the idea for the French Dragon Ball theme park arose from a 2025 meeting between French President Emmanuel Macron and Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. Each leader learned the other was a huge fan of Akira Toriyama 's iconic franchise.

The project will be financed by Qiddiya, a Saudi entertainment and investment group. It's the same company that's constructing the Dragon Ball theme park in Qiddiya City, a still-being-developed entertainment hub outside of Riyadh. That park will house over five rides, 30 attractions, a 230-foot Shenron, hotels, and restaurants.

Another Dragon Ball theme park is just one of Saudi Arabia's many forays into sports and entertainment as an attempt to launder its public image via " sportswashing." It has previously established the LIV Golf league and recently completed the Public Investment Fund's (PIF) purchase of gaming giant EA, among other investments.

Ahead of the footage being posted more widely, several Reddit users believe that infrastructure including the main CyberLeek domain and backup spelling variants were registered as early as August 14. They also claim that a $CYBERLEEK token, liquidity pool, website, and voting program were created around August 15.

The first clip was around a minute long, and showed protagonist Jason Duval outside the oceanside house that's already been seen in official Rockstar marketing material. It showed off a Focus mechanic, where making a basket increased Jason's Focus level, as shown on the HUD. It's unclear whether this Focus system is present across all of the gameplay, or only in minigames such as basketball. It was initially unclear whether the footage was genuine, but as Rockstar begin issuing DMCA takedown notices, it appeared to verify the legitimacy.

articles.title: The 'Black Mirror' of Roblox Games Disappears After Hitting No. 1
articles.summary: Steal a Brainrot is so 2025. These days, the most popular game on Roblox is Steal an Egg — but the pet simulator is getting attention for all the wrong reasons. It's one of the most dystopian things ever released on Roblox and is being likened to one of the more depressing episodes of Netflix's…
body: As the name implies, Steal an Egg is an experience where players collect and raise eggs. Hatched eggs turn into pets that generate money every second of their existence, with rarer animals earning more cash than typical monsters. Most players start humbly, with a small chicken — but with enough progress, fans can raise fantastical creatures like dragons. All players have a base, and much like Steal a Brainrot, other people on the server can run away with your assets. Players can also gain eggs by stealing them from various biomes across the map. Each biome has a guardian; the better the egg, the harder it is to steal.

The primary thing that determines success here is speed. Speed can be purchased with real-world money, or it can be upgraded manually by running on a treadmill. Treadmills have a built-in feature called Reels that allows users to watch videos to help pass the time. Screenshots showing this mechanic in action are currently going viral on social media, where shocked onlookers are calling Steal an Egg 's treadmill mechanic dystopian. Many of those screenshots stem from a YouTube video uploaded by a user called Foltyn that generated 1.3 million views on the video platform.

articles.title: Tom Hardy’s $478M Sci-Fi Action Movie Officially Surges to #2 on Netflix
articles.summary: Over the years, Tom Hardy has proven to be one of the most versatile actors around. He's starred in Oscar-winning dramas like Alejandro Iñárritu's The Revenant and led blockbuster smash hits like Mad Max: Fury Road.
body: Fresh off the success of Spider-Man: Homecoming, Sony launched its own Spider-Man Universe in 2018 with Venom. Tom Hardy was cast in the dual lead roles of Eddie Brock and Venom (previously portrayed by Topher Grace in Sam Rami’s Spider-Man 3 ). The prospect of a movie about a Spider-Man villain that didn't include Spider-Man was a weird pitch, and Hardy delivered an equally unconventional performance to match. It's that charming commitment to the role that made Venom a cult hit.

Fans especially latched onto the romantic side of Eddie and Venom's relationship, which 2021's Venom: Let There Be Carnage would lean into. While Sony's other Spider-Man Universe films like Morbius and Madame Web crashed and burned, becoming fodder for endless memes, Venom persisted. In 2024, Hardy returned for Venom: The Last Dance, which is now the second-most streamed movie on Netflix.

articles.title: A disturbing '90s point-and-click horror game about waking up in a rundown asylum with no recollection of who you are is getting a glow up in 2026
articles.summary: 1998 was a vintage year for PC gaming: Half-Life, Unreal, StarCraft, Thief and Baldur's Gate all released in lavish oversize retail boxes, and it was just as busy in console land: Ocarina of Time and Banjo-Kazooie released on Nintendo 64, while the original PlayStation enjoyed Metal Gear Solid and…
body: Into this crowd of future classics was also Sanitarium, which shuffled onto shelves, probably sheepishly, in April 1998. It's an isometric point-and-click adventure starring Max, an amnesiac who wakes in a bizarre, rundown sanitarium. Lest you think this is a game about exploring a slightly eerie rundown hospital, let me disabuse you of that notion immediately: For fear of spoiling everything, I can only say: this game goes places.

Richard Cobbett wrote about Sanitarium in his Crapshoot column, and Alexis Ong even went as far as to track down its creators. If you've played Sanitarium—especially divorced from its mid '90s context—you're probably evangelical about it. It carefully balances the line between camp and psychologically gruelling, but questions of tone aside, it's a gorgeously vivid and varied thing, with beautifully rendered isometric environments.

articles.title: 38 Years Later, The Best 'Calvin and Hobbes' Mom Quote Is Still Unmatched in Comic Strip History
articles.summary: Calvin’s mom doesn't get enough credit. Within Bill Watterson’s classic comic strip Calvin and Hobbes, Calvin’s mom, who is a homemaker, is Calvin’s number one nurturer and the person preparing nearly all of his meals (which Calvin definitely doesn’t appreciate).
body: There’s a ton of love for Calvin’s dad. People love that, just for his own amusement, Calvin's dad will make up absurd lies, like when Calvin asks his dad where babies come from, only for his dad to say “Most people just go to Sears, buy the kit, and follow the assembly instructions.” But Calvin’s mom — who, like Calvin’s dad, has no name — doesn’t get nearly as much love. Even Watterson himself has admitted that he underserved the character.

“Calvin's mom is the daily disciplinarian, a job that taxes her sanity, so I don't think we get to see her at her best,” Watterson once explained. “I regret that the strip mostly shows her impatient side, but I try to hint at other aspects of her personality and her interests by what she's doing when Calvin barges in.”

Calvin’s mom can be just as funny as his dad, and it usually comes when the strip shows her impatient side. So to show her a bit of the respect that is so well deserved, we’ve decided to track down her best ever quote from the comic strip, and share a bit more of what’s so great about her along the way.

articles.summary: You ever get the feeling that a game is about to make a big splash, but nobody you know is talking about it yet? That's where I've been with Wardogs, the 100-player milsim FPS that I haven't stopped thinking about for weeks.
body: Developer Bulkhead held a closed beta this past weekend for those who pre-ordered the $40 early access release, which reached over 100,000 peak Steam players on Sunday—more simultaneous players than Squad, Hell Let Loose, or Arma has ever seen on PC. In a beta debrief video published today, game director Howard Philpott said nearly 500,000 total players tried Wardogs.

"The reaction from the FPS community has been insane," Philpott said, "with nearly half a million unique players showing up to play the closed beta the same week as Call of Duty's beta and Battlefield 6's massive update."

I don't share these figures to stoke obsessive number comparisons between very different flavors of shooter, but to point out how different it is for an FPS as crunchy and complex as Wardogs to already have an audience this large.

articles.title: A game dev spent 40 days in the wilderness to make this new Steam survival game
articles.summary: I've always wondered how I'd fare in a survival situation. Lost in the woods, with no food or water, how long would I last? Would I make good choices? Could I find my way back to safety?
body: The answers to those questions are almost certainly "Not long, no, and definitely not," and hopefully I'll never have to actually find out. In the meantime, I try to live out my survival fantasies through films and games, and Wordless Forest, which launched on Steam today, is sorta both.

Wordless Forest is an FMV survival game solo developer Dogus Cagrici shot while hiking in the "dense forests and wilderness of four different cities across Turkey for 40 days." It's completely dialogue-free (hence the title) as the character Cagrici plays finds himself alone in the wilds, trying to find his way to safety and put his scrambled memories back together after a head injury.

body: We're not going to be commenting on leaks from a stolen GTA 6 build that's years old and promoting a memecoin but we WILL be talking about Sony's comments on not knowing PS6's pricing and release date and assessing the Black Myth Zhong Kui gameplay reveal. Rich is intrigued by Alan Wake's big PC upgrade for AMD users, while John muses over the reported end of live service elements in Horizon Hunters Gathering. Finally, five years ago, Alex made a range of predictions about Switch 2 and DLSS... so how accurate did they turn out to be?
points: Purchase an eligible QD-OLED display and share your feedback for the chance to get a game code for Onimusha: Way of the Sword
